version: OpenAI Sora app and Sora 2 API (both shut down)
genus: OpenAI's video app, now shut down
launched_note: The Sora app with Sora 2 launched 30 Sep 2025; app closed 26 Apr 2026; API closed 24 Sep 2026.
test: Desk study: OpenAI's deprecation notice and press coverage, plus the free plans of three places to make AI videos now.
verdict_reason: Sora is gone, and so are the videos people didn't export. For new videos: Kling's app has free credits with an account; Wan is free and open source, but its free demo page was not working when we checked.
lesson: Keep your own copies of anything you make on a hosted AI tool: when it shuts down, the files can go with it.

successors.line: Open source; its demo was down

sources.label: OpenAI deprecations: Sora 2 and Videos API

tested_on_note: Research date (desk study; nothing left to test).
